in_force: The current consolidation on 2026-10-24: Act No. 21311 of 2026-01-20 (partial amendment), effective 2026-07-21 for the provisions its addendum defers, and from 2026-01-22 for the rest. The Act as enacted was Act No. 20676 of 2025-01-21, in force 'one year after promulgation' (addendum Art 1). Of the provisions this encoding reads (Arts 2, 4, 31, 32, 33, 34, 36, 40, 43), only Art 2 carries an amendment mark (<개정 2026. 1. 20.>), and Act No. 21311's addendum puts that amendment in force on 2026-01-22, the day the Act itself took effect. The deferred provisions (from 2026-07-21) are Art 3(5), 6(2)7-8, 16(3)-(5) in part, 17-2, 18, 22-3 and Art 35(1) second sentence.
